supersedes: configs/p5_e8_calib_v2.json (never run; preserved). v2 was replaced before any calibration result because its gate would fail an exactly valid test with probability 0.879 (results/calib_contract_audit/p5_e8_calib_v2.md), and because the E8 dataset key omitted the test level.
preserved_verdicts: v1 EH1 FAIL and the model-stage STOP are unchanged by this config.
seed_scheme: seeds.seed_v2 over {experiment, joint, condition, level, example, replicate, branch}; rows, direct samples, sequential samples and permutations use separate keys; target- and joint-level cells never share rows or samples

design.statistic: T = mean_i ED_V(direct_i, sequential_i); target level on z/0.5; joint level = mean over 8 fixed directions (angles pi*t/8, t=0..7) of the projected ED_V on (y/2, z/0.5); upper tail
design.randomisation: within each conditioning example, branch labels of the 2M pooled samples are reassigned uniformly over all C(2M, M) allocations; never across examples; a joint sample (y, z) is relabelled as one unit
design.p_value: (1 + #{b: T_b >= T_obs - tol}) / (B + 1), ties counted as extreme, tol = 1e-12 (1 + |T_obs|); never 0
design.backend: loop backend (PooledExample). The array-at-a-time backend is verified identical on exact fixtures but is slower, so it is not used.

sampling_contract.direct: M i.i.d. draws from q_d(z|x_i) (target level) or q_d(y,z|x_i) (joint level)
sampling_contract.sequential: M i.i.d. pairs; every pair draws a fresh intermediate y_ij ~ q(y|x_i) and then z_ij ~ q(z|x_i, y_ij); no intermediate is reused
sampling_contract.independence: direct and sequential use different seed_v2 keys (independent random streams); no common random numbers across branches, levels, cells or replicates
sampling_contract.units: conditioning examples are the independent units inside a replicate; replicates (fresh rows) are the units of the rejection-rate estimate; samples and permutations are never units

estimand_and_identification.target: H0_T: q_d(z|x_i) = q_s(z|x_i) for every example. The test is exact under H0_T and consistent against any difference of the target laws.
estimand_and_identification.joint: The test is exact under full equality of the joint laws of (y, z)|x_i. Its statistic depends only on the 8 projected laws, so it has power only against differences visible in those projections. Non-rejection does not establish joint equality, and rejection says nothing about directions not tested. Within the Gaussian family, 8 directions identify the law; in general they do not.
estimand_and_identification.not_tested: global existence of a joint for all conditionals of a model; factorization consistency (C2); correctness relative to the truth (a quality question)

mean_shift_0.1.changes_truth_quality: sequential branch biased by 0.1 tau; expected CRPS excess 0.0028 (standardised)

var_ratio_1.25.changes_truth_quality: sequential branch over-dispersed (sd ratio 1.118); expected CRPS excess 0.0018

collapse_intermediate.changes_truth_quality: one-sided collapse: sequential branch under-dispersed (sd ratio 0.735), Cov(y,z|x) 0.54 -> 0; expected CRPS excess 0.0113. It is a genuine compatibility alternative because only one branch collapses.

corr_scale_-1|joint.changes_truth_quality: target law is exactly the truth; joint Cov(y,z|x) flips 0.54 -> -0.54; target CRPS excess 0

cells.note: target marginal preserved exactly: a null for the target test
same perturbation as the target-level null cell; alternative only at the joint level

quality_metrics: for every dataset: per-example fair CRPS of each branch against the held-out z_obs minus the closed-form CRPS of the true conditional N(E[z|x], tau^2) at z_obs (excess CRPS vs truth, mean over examples with normal 95% CI); oracle sd ratio sd(z samples)/tau

gate.G1_primary_tolerance: primary null cell: one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson upper bound of the rejection rate <= 0.10 (passes iff k <= 29 of 400). Engineering tolerance only; it does not establish size 0.05.
gate.G2_null_family_no_excess: no null-validity cell has its one-sided Clopper-Pearson lower bound at level 1 - 0.05/4 above 0.05 (Bonferroni over the 4 null cells)
gate.G3_power_family: every power cell POWERED: one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson lower bound > 0.05 (k >= 6 of 50); an always-accept rule cannot pass
gate.quality_controls: reported separately and not part of the gate. Expected: the compatibility test does not reject collapse_both (both branches are the same point mass), while the excess-CRPS-vs-truth CI lower bound is > 0 and the sd ratio is 0 in every replicate.
gate.negative_controls: always-accept and always-reject rules evaluated with G1-G3 must fail

multiplicity.per_test: each replicate of a cell is one test at alpha = 0.05; no p-value adjustment inside the calibration (it estimates the size of a single test)
multiplicity.gate: Bonferroni over the 4-cell null family for the EXCESS flags; the power family is a conjunction; quality controls are outside the gate
multiplicity.p_resolution: B = 199 gives p on a grid of 0.005 with exact size 0.050 at alpha = 0.05; any later Bonferroni family with more than 10 tests cannot reject at all with B = 199 and needs B >= ceil(m/alpha) - 1, preferably far more

stop_rule: run once. If the gate fails, report FAIL; do not change estimator, statistic, seeds, B, N, M, R or thresholds and do not re-run. Diagnose only with the declared checks (fixture enumeration, per-cell summaries).

budget.note: calibration run authorised by the user instruction of 2026-09-26; cells not finished within max_wall_seconds are reported NOT_RUN, never PASS
budget.estimate_source: timing smoke with a different seed (999), one replicate per cell, not reported: about 1.6 s per target task and 7 s per joint task
